en: A vintage black-and-white postcard showing a large railway station with arched windows and a colonnaded platform. Many people are standing on the platform, and an old steam locomotive with several cars is visible on the right. The station building is labelled 'ZEMUN' and has ornate architectural details. The card has printed text in multiple languages, including 'Zemun' (top left), 'Pályaudvar – Bahnhof' (top right), and handwritten notes in German across the top.
